Job Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or Business
- At least 2 years of experience in data visualization and reporting
- Must have strong expertise in Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Advanced Excel, and Business Intelligence
- Experience building executive dashboards and complex SQL queries
Bonus:
- Proficiency in Python, DAX, and Data Warehousing is preferred
- Excellent communication and presentation skills
